system.description: The Bruid hears all noises and conversations within range. A pair of griffon’s ears emerges from the Bruid’s head for the duration of the ability. To be able to fully listen to a certain noise or conversation, the Bruid needs to succeed on a Situation roll with a Situation value of 14. It is up to the game master to increase or decrease this Situation value depending on how busy the environment surrounding the dimwalker is, such as: nature +5, settlement ±0, busy town +5, and so on.
